tickets.title: Address mortgage servicing and title update after spouse death
tickets.text: Address mortgage servicing and title update for Sera Bramblequill's primary residence with the mortgage servicer and county title office after Aaron Bramblequill's death, while she continues payments from the Teacup Comet Bank joint checking account.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the mortgage servicing and title update by 2025-09-26.

tickets.title: Organize Moonbadger Life death benefit claim packet
tickets.text: Organize the Moonbadger Life death benefit claim packet and track insurer requirements for Sera Bramblequill as primary beneficiary on Aaron Bramblequill's $500,000 term life policy.
tickets.evidence: For the Moonbadger Life beneficiary claim, Sera showed the policy page naming her as primary beneficiary and asked Apricot Compass Advisory to help organize the carrier claim packet and track the insurer’s requirements for the death benefit. The agreed follow-up is due 2025-09-12.
